children: Vietnam's State Treasury raised 15 trillion dong ($578 million) in its weekly government bond auction on Wednesday, up from $97 million raised last week.
The uptake was higher, with 68% of the bonds on offer sold, compared with 15% last week, according to a Hanoi Stock Exchange filing.
The treasury sold 7 trillion dong out of the 8 trillion dong of 5-year bonds on offer, at a coupon of 4.26%.
It sold 8 trillion dong out of the 12 trillion dong of 10-year bonds on offer, at a coupon of 4.43%.
It failed to offload any of the combined 2 trillion dong of 3-, 15- and 30-year bonds on offer.
The government aims to raise 500 trillion dong from bond sales this year. So far it has raised over 235 trillion dong.
Vietnamese companies have raised 356 trillion dong via bonds this year up to September 4, according to bond market association data.
The total value of corporate bonds maturing during the remainder of this year is 92 trillion dong.
